entries.note: New Year's Eve dawn - quiet streets

closures.note: Last day of the year. Started guitar, built a running habit, began French. Proud of the consistency.

reflections.note: Year-end reflection: I started three major habits this year — guitar, running, and French. Photography became a surprise passion. The biggest lesson is that doing a little every day matters more than doing a lot once a week. Looking forward to what 2026 brings.
